question: How much might a software developer expect to get paid per hour?
sql:
SELECT
    "salarydetails"."hourly_rate" AS "expected_hourly_rate"
FROM
    "salarydetails"
JOIN
    "position" ON "salarydetails"."positionid" = "position"."id"
WHERE
    LOWER("position"."title") LIKE '%software developer%'
    AND "salarydetails"."hourly_rate" IS NOT NULL;

question: List all the job positions and the associated salary range.
sql:
SELECT
    p."title" AS job_position,
    sd."salary_range" AS salary_range
FROM
    "position" p
LEFT JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid";
